proposal: Convert the integral garage to a bedroom

pages.text:
Site: 22 Finch Road, Eastmere
Dwelling: semi-detached, 3 bedrooms now, 4 after works
Proposal: convert integral garage to a fourth bedroom
Parking after works: one space on the drive; the garage space is lost
The site is 1.2 km from the Town Centre Zone boundary.

The garage door is replaced by a window and brick panel to match the house.
No extension is proposed.
